# alienctl

> alienctl is the local/BYOC pre-review control and evidence layer for AI-generated software changes.

Canonical URL: https://alienctl.com/
Contact: joel.rietz.le@gmail.com

## Core resources

- [AI-agent change control](https://alienctl.com/guides/ai-agent-change-control/): definition, control boundary, workflow, and limitations.
- [Review AI-generated code](https://alienctl.com/guides/review-ai-generated-code/): practical pre-review workflow and checklist.

## Product boundary

alienctl observes a bounded AI-agent repository session, evaluates declared
verification and local policy evidence, and produces a reviewer-readable
workflow decision. It does not prove code correctness, production safety,
compliance, or ROI. The current pilot is local and buyer-controlled.

Runtime guardrails decide whether an agent action may execute. Enterprise
governance platforms oversee AI assets and organizational risk. alienctl
decides whether the resulting engineering change has enough evidence and
approval to begin human review. It does not currently claim compatibility
with Microsoft Agent Control Specification or IBM watsonx.governance.
